messages:
jess: Heads-up: NOVA sent the security pack back. Highlights: 3yr WORM-style audit retention, Splunk-compatible export, FIPS-validated HSM attestation for CMKs, strict svcacct separation (no cross-tenant role inheritance), and 24h SLA for Critical vuln triage. They also requested a POA&M for any gaps. Can we scope a response + timeline?

tariq: Link to their questionnaire: https://nova.example/sec-q/2026. Quick read: most asks are procedural; HSM attestation + 24h SLA are the big asks. We currently do 72h for criticals unless enterprise contract says otherwise.

anna: For audit retention: we can enable object lock on our S3 exports and keep signed daily snapshots. We have a script that produces Splunk HEC-ready NDJSON with metadata: `scripts/export_for_splunk.sh --tenant nova --from 2024-01-01 --to now`

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded to /artifacts/nova/sec-evidence/2026-03-04/ (read-only). Contains: daily-signed-hashchain.tar.gz (2.1GB), redacted-rbac.csv.gpg, splunk-ready-ndjson.gz. ACL check passed.

jess: Good. Anna, can you add short instructions on verification steps for their auditors? e.g., how to check hash chain and object lock headers.

anna: Yup. I'll add a checklist: 1) verify S3 objectlock headers with `aws s3api head-object`, 2) verify signature with our GPG public key, 3) compare SHA256 in chain-manifest. Draft will be in the artifact dir.

tariq: KMS/HSM: we support customer BYOK with CMKs on AWS CloudHSM or Azure HSM. We can provide key-attestation docs from the provider when keys are customer-provisioned. For Redwood-managed keys we use cloud KMS CA certs but cannot produce HSM attestation reports (provider-owned). Need to confirm whether NOVA will accept provider certs or requires tenant-origin HSM attestation.

jess: @lloyd can you ask procurement/sales if NOVA will sign for BYOK costs? If they insist on attestation for managed keys we'll need to push for BYOK + cost pass-through.

lloyd: Yep, I'll ping them now and get back. If they require attestation for managed keys that's a chargeable enterprise add-on.

anna: RBAC evidence: we can export role bindings and service-account policies scoped to tenant. Example command we use internally (kube-style): `redwoodctl iam list-bindings --tenant nova --format csv > nova-bindings.csv` then we run `redact-emails nova-bindings.csv | gpg --sign --armor > nova-bindings.csv.asc`

infra-bot: Sample redacted output preview (first 3 lines):
```
role,member,scope
read_only,svcacct-data-processor,tenant:nova
admin,svcacct-deploy-ops,tenant:nova
```

tariq: Vulnerability SLA: 24h is aggressive. Proposal: 24h for Critical with an enterprise SLA contract + onboarding (incident runbook and on-call rotation). Otherwise standard 72h. We'll document POA&M for any deviations.

jess: Sounds fair. Add remediation ETA examples in the POA&M: temporary mitigations, planned patch window, verification steps.

anna: Timeline commitments: evidence packet (signed exports, RBAC CSV, retention policy, Splunk export instructions) ready in 48 hours; KMS attestation path clarifying note in 3 business days (depends on provider); POA&M template + draft responses in 48 hours; vuln SLA negotiation with sales by EOD Monday.

lloyd: I have outreach scheduled with NOVA's procurement this afternoon. I'll confirm BYOK cost acceptance and whether they will accept provider CA-level attestations for managed keys.

jess: Great. I'll start drafting the questionnaire answers and mark attestation + 24h SLA as pending items with proposed mitigations. Please drop any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
